assumptions: Board is an axis-aligned uniform grid whose candy sprites are saturated non-blue blobs; board background is blue.
Cell pitch equals median nearest-neighbour blob distance; grid axes derived from clustered blob centroids inside the largest regular column chain.
Hue ranges map to canonical candy colors; teal gummy-bear pixels and white frosting tiles are reported as blocker.
Frosted cells with no visible candy color are reported empty/blocker rather than a candy color.
Greedy largest-resulting-run swap is an acceptable move policy.
limitations: Special candies (striped, wrapped, fish, color bomb) are labeled by base color only; their extra effects are not modeled.
Irregular board outlines are approximated by the bounding rectangle; non-playable holes may be labeled empty.
No detection of locks, honey or multi-layer frosting that make a swap invalid.
Animation/overlay frames are rejected only via unknown-label fraction, so some unsettled frames may be missed.
Level goals, moves left and score are not read; signature covers grid geometry and labels only.
